horses.incident_text: Near the 900 Metres was steadied and shifted out to avoid MALPENSA. <22/12/2025 Additional Veterinary Report>The Veterinary Surgeon reported that TORVEIN was lame in its left front leg on the morning after racing. Before being allowed to race again, TORVEIN will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

When questioned  Z Purton stated that his mount was fractious in the starting gates and as a consequence jumped only fairly.  He said throughout the early stages MALPENSA was reluctant to hold its position to the inside of other runners and approaching the first turn near the 900 Metres he was obliged to severely check his mount when MALPENSA shifted out when reluctant to hold its position to the inside of GREAT SPIRIT which shifted in slightly.  He added that as a consequence MALPENSA lost significant ground and did not finish the race off thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The racing manners of MALPENSA were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, MALPENSA will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial around a bend in Hong Kong from an inside barrier.  Noted to have lost its left front plate after the race.

Crowded on jumping between NEZHA and MULTIDUTCH which shifted out.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  When questioned H Bowman stated that from a wide barrier he was instructed to find cover on the horse.  He said when caught wide in the early stages he was obliged to settle further back in the field to ensure that he complied with his instructions to obtain cover.  When questioned regarding his riding from the 600 Metres and the reason his mount was held up for clear running in the Home Straight after improving to the inside of SPECIAL HEDGE, H Bowman stated that from the 600 Metres he did not wish to make a forward move as he was concerned had he shifted out that SPECIAL HEDGE would force his mount wider.  He said as a consequence he remained racing behind SPECIAL HEDGE and when that runner then shifted out near the 500 Metres AUDACIOUS PURSUIT, which was travelling well, then improved to the inside of SPECIAL HEDGE.  He added that when SPECIAL HEDGE did not continue to improve into the race AUDACIOUS PURSUIT then became held up for clear running when he was required to shift his mount to the outside of SPECIAL HEDGE in the early stages of the Home Straight to obtain clear running.  He said after he improved to the outside of SPECIAL HEDGE leaving the 300 Metres AUDACIOUS PURSUIT finished the race off in a satisfactory manner.  After considering his explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Bowman were reasonable in the circumstances.
